name: @computerjs/sdk
description: Computer.js Web SDK - call real computer capabilities (screen, mouse, keyboard, apps, files) from a webpage, with user approval

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/computer.js && esbuild src/browser.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/computer.iife.js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
